messages.content: 我想在聖荷西附近的Walmart買蘋果、米飯和12罐瓶裝水。請顯示產品資訊和庫存情況。

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to buy apples, rice, and 12 cans of bottled water near San Jose Walmart. They want product info and inventory status. We need to call the function walmart_purchase with loc "San Jose" or maybe "nearby" but we can specify location as "San Jose". product_list includes "apples", "rice", "bottled water". For pack_size, we have 12 cans of bottled water. So pack_size array should match product_list length. For apples and rice, no pack size needed; default not used. But we might set pack_size as [null, null, 12] or just omit? The function signature says pack_size optional. If we provide pack_size array, its length should equal product_list. We could provide [0, 0, 12] or [null, null, 12]. But better to provide only for bottled water. But then array length mismatch. So we either provide pack_size for all items: e.g., [1, 1, 12] meaning one apple, one rice, twelve water. But apples and rice may come in packs. But we can set pack_size as [1, 1, 12] or [null, null, 12]. Let's do [null, null, 12] to indicate default usage for first two. Or we can skip pack_size entirely. But the function expects pack_size optional. If omitted, default not used. That means we don't specify pack_size. But we need to specify quantity? The function doesn't include quantity. It only has pack_size for each item. So we can't specify quantity for apples and rice. But we can set pack_size to 12 for bottled water. For apples and rice, we can set pack_size to 1 or leave unspecified. But the array length must equal product_list. So we can set pack_size: [1, 1, 12]. That indicates one apple, one rice, twelve water. That seems fine.

Thus call function:

{
  "loc": "San Jose",
  "product_list": ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"],
  "pack_size": [1, 1, 12]
}

We will call the function.
